slides.text: Near Cluj-Napoca, Romania: the Hoia-Baciu forest.
Legend says it's named after a shepherd who walked in with 200 sheep... and was never seen again.
The trees here grow twisted and bent.
In the middle there's a clearing, an almost perfect circle where the trees just stop.
In 1968, a military technician photographed what he said was a UFO over that clearing.
Visitors talk about strange lights, lost time, and the feeling of being watched.
Today you can book night tours. Locals have their own advice: don't go alone.
